title: Using a Neural Network Architecture for the Prediction of Neurologic Outcome for Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrests Using Hospital Level Variables and Novel Physiologic Markers.
summary: A neural network predicted neurologic outcomes among out-of-hospital cardiac-arrest patients who achieved return of circulation and reached hospital. Reported performance is hypothesis-generating in a small retrospective cohort.
